What's the most surprising metric you've tracked when switching LLM providers? I've seen token efficiency vary by 40% on the same task.

Your experience lines up with what I see in production: the right harness can cut costs and lift quality. But chasing a 0% token waste rate is usually a trap—some redundancy keeps agents reliable.

comments.author: ANURAG MISHRA
comments.comment:
Most multi-agent systems still treat collaboration as a sequence of handoffs, not a true shared workspace. That's why they step on each other's work.

Sayabot's CRDT canvas for live orchestration is a smart move. It tackles the core coordination problem directly, which is more important than just chaining API calls.
